issues.description: The Solution repository's Person model declares the field 'firstName' as type int, while the Template repository (and the exercise intent) use String for firstName. This is an internal type mismatch in the solution that will cause compile errors in the reference implementation and confuse students when they compare the template and solution. The problem statement and tests treat firstName as a String (setFirstName is called with String values), so the int declaration in the solution is incorrect and prevents the solution from compiling and matching the template behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the declaration of 'firstName' in the Solution repository's Person.java from 'private int firstName;' to 'private String firstName;'. Ensure the getter/setter and equals/hashCode usages remain consistent with String. Rebuild to verify the solution compiles and tests referencing setFirstName(String) work as intended.
